summary: The argument is mathematically complete. The fiber count and Hausdorff-mass identity are valid; the entropy identities, displacement-convexity estimate, feasibility of the two-core coarsening, and conditional-entropy comparison yield (6) with the stated constants. The scalar inequalities (7)-(8), their combination into (9), the change-of-measure/Jensen step giving (10), the sharpness example, and the symmetric specialization all check exactly, including boundary cases a,b,m=0.
